Clean-room independence

Reproduction and independent implementation are different.

External reproduction

An unrelated person runs a BTG-controlled implementation and independently confirms environment, pass/fail state and hashes. This is useful portability/reproducibility evidence.

Independent implementation

An unrelated implementer controls their own repository, architecture, libraries and source and builds from public specification/conformance material without copying BTG implementations.

A fork, translation or port of BTG code does not become independent evidence merely because it lives in another repository. Negative results, ambiguities and incompatible interpretations are welcome when documented precisely.
